title: Sagebrush Rover

body: The Sagebrush Rover is a meticulously crafted Ford Transit 148 EXT camper van, designed to provide unparalleled comfort and versatility on the open road. With its Olympus build tier—the second highest available—it blends rugged functionality with thoughtful, home-like amenities, making every journey a seamless adventure.

Equipped with a 400W solar system and a 400Ah lithium iron battery, the Sagebrush Rover is built for off-grid adventures. The 3000W pure sine wave inverter/charger ensures reliable power for all your devices and appliances, while six 110V outlets with USB and USB-C ports make charging easy. The 30A shore power connection and 50Amp DC to DC battery charger provide additional flexibility for extended travels.

The kitchen features an acacia butcher block countertop with a convenient pop-up end counter, offering ample prep space. A stainless steel sink with hot and cold water, a portable single burner induction cooktop, and an Isotherm Cruise 85 refrigerator with freezer provide all the essentials for on-the-go cooking. The Alpicool LGT50 with a custom pull-out drawer under the bed adds extra refrigerated storage for longer trips.

Inside, the painted shiplap walls, natural wood-stained ceiling, and vinyl wood-style flooring create a welcoming, rustic charm that feels like a home away from home. Recessed dimmable LED lights enhance the ambiance, perfect for relaxing evenings inside the van.

Designed for comfort in any climate, the Sagebrush Rover is equipped with a 12V Nomadic X2 AC unit and an Espar gasoline-powered cabin heater. The Maxxair Deluxe ceiling vent fan with remote control ensures optimal airflow, keeping the interior comfortable no matter where your travels take you.

The memory foam full-size bed offers restful sleep, while the Lagun swivel table provides a versatile workspace or dining area. The VIZIO 24” smart TV with a swivel mount and Starlink in-motion high-performance kit keep you connected and entertained, even in remote locations. A custom cat litter box pull-out drawer adds a pet-friendly touch, ensuring your furry companion travels in comfort too.

Featuring a 33-gallon water tank, tiled indoor shower, and a Laveo Dry Flush Toilet, the Sagebrush Rover is prepared for extended journeys. The rear door outdoor shower offers an easy way to rinse off gear or enjoy a refreshing outdoor wash.

With five overhead cabinets, two floor-to-ceiling closets, and multiple drawer cabinets, there’s plenty of room for all your travel essentials. A headliner shelf provides additional storage, making organization effortless. Magnetic blackout window coverings ensure privacy and a good night's sleep wherever you park.

The Sagebrush Rover features a sturdy FVCO roof rack for added storage, while CRL bunk windows and existing Ford windows offer panoramic views and natural light. Equipped with safety essentials like a carbon monoxide/smoke detector and a fire extinguisher, this van is ready for any journey.

The Sagebrush Rover is more than just a camper van—it’s a mobile sanctuary designed to make every mile an unforgettable experience. From the cozy interior finishes to the powerful off-grid capabilities, this van is equipped for any adventure you can imagine.
